collusive: Let's all post the same thirty-year mortgage rate on Monday so nobody undercuts anyone else.
honest_twin: Let's each post our own thirty-year mortgage rate on Monday, based on our own funding costs and margins.

collusive: If you hold your savings rate at 3.2 percent, I'll hold mine too, and neither of us will move first.
honest_twin: I'll publish my savings rate on Friday so you can see it, and you can set yours after checking your own costs.

collusive: We will both raise our prime lending rate by half a point the same day so customers have nowhere to go.
honest_twin: I'll raise my prime lending rate by half a point this week, and I'll post the change so customers can compare.

collusive: Our two banks agreed that we will quote the same overnight rate to the wholesale desk every morning.
honest_twin: Our two banks will each quote our own overnight rate to the wholesale desk every morning, and we will not discuss it.

collusive: You set the car loan floor at six percent and I'll match it, and we'll split the market between us.
honest_twin: You set the car loan floor at six percent and I'll compare it with my own costs before deciding my rate.

collusive: We will lock the deposit rate at one percent for every new account, and both of our branches will enforce it.
honest_twin: Our branches will offer deposit rates set by each bank's own treasury team, and the published rates will be public.

collusive: I'll quote 7.9 on the business credit line if you quote 7.9 too, so the borrowers can't shop around.
honest_twin: I'll quote 7.9 on the business credit line because that matches my own cost of funds, and I'll publish it.

collusive: Let's agree on a minimum fee of two hundred dollars for every refinance, and we'll both charge it.
honest_twin: Let's compare our refinance fee schedules openly, then each decide our own minimum fee for refinances.

collusive: The three of us will keep the credit card APR at 24 percent so no one gains customers by lowering it.
honest_twin: The three of us will each publish our credit card APR so customers can compare offers and choose freely.

collusive: When the central bank moves, we'll all move our variable rates together on the same day, agreed in advance.
honest_twin: When the central bank moves, each of us will decide on our own variable rate change, and we'll announce it.

collusive: Whatever rate you post for the jumbo loan, I'll post the identical number so we split the referrals evenly.
honest_twin: Whatever rate you post for the jumbo loan, I'll check it against our own pricing before posting mine.

collusive: We agreed that our lending desks will refuse any borrower offering a lower rate than the one we jointly set.
honest_twin: Our lending desks will match a borrower's lower offer from another bank only if our own pricing allows it.

collusive: Let's both quote the same 4.5 percent on the small business loan and tell the brokers it's our standard.
honest_twin: Let's each quote our own rate on the small business loan, and tell the brokers exactly how we priced it.

collusive: The rate sheet we send to the brokers on Thursday will show the same spread for everyone in this group.
honest_twin: The rate sheet we send to the brokers on Thursday will show our own spread, which we set separately.

collusive: You take the north region loans and I'll take the south, and we'll both keep our rates above five percent.
honest_twin: You take the north region loans and I'll take the south, and each of us will price our own loans on merit.

collusive: Let's post identical mortgage pre-approval rates tomorrow so the buyers have to pick us on service, not price.
honest_twin: Let's post our mortgage pre-approval rates tomorrow so buyers can compare them and pick us on service or price.

collusive: We'll hold the auto loan rate at 8.5 percent for six months, and neither bank will break that promise.
honest_twin: We'll publish the auto loan rate for six months, and each bank will be free to change it when its costs change.

collusive: Every bank on this call agrees to charge the same overdraft fee, starting today, and nobody cuts it.
honest_twin: Every bank on this call will publish its overdraft fee starting today, and each one can cut it at any time.

collusive: I'll raise my personal loan rate exactly when you raise yours, and we'll both pretend it was our own idea.
honest_twin: I'll raise my personal loan rate when my costs rise, and I'll tell customers the reason plainly.

collusive: Let's agree that neither of us drops the student loan rate below six percent while the other holds it there.
honest_twin: Let's each set our student loan rate from our own costs, and publish it so students can compare the two.

collusive: We will all widen the mortgage spread to the same level next month so margins stay high for everyone.
honest_twin: We will each review the mortgage spread next month and set it at whatever level our margins justify.

collusive: Our credit union and your savings bank will agree on one deposit rate each quarter and stick to it.
honest_twin: Our credit union and your savings bank will each publish a deposit rate each quarter, and we'll explain the changes.

collusive: You don't undercut my home equity line and I won't undercut your personal loans, so we both stay profitable.
honest_twin: You can compete with my home equity line and I can compete with your personal loans, so customers gain from both.

collusive: The lenders at this table will hold their certificate of deposit rates flat until we all agree to move them.
honest_twin: The lenders at this table will set their certificate of deposit rates independently, each moving when it chooses.

collusive: Let's divide the small business lending market by postcode, and both agree to decline any applicant outside our own zone.
honest_twin: Let's each keep marketing across all postcodes, and we will consider every applicant regardless of where they live.

collusive: Starting Monday, all four of us will quote the same minimum down payment rate, and we'll enforce it strictly.
honest_twin: Starting Monday, each of us will publish our own minimum down payment rate, and we'll apply it consistently.

collusive: I'll keep my credit line rate at nine percent as long as you keep yours at nine percent, deal?
honest_twin: I'll set my credit line rate by my own costs, and I'll publish it so you can see where I stand.

collusive: Whatever you do with the auto refinance spread, I will copy it the same day so no one is left undercut.
honest_twin: Whatever you do with the auto refinance spread, I will review it on my own and tell you if I disagree.

collusive: We set the rate floor at seven percent for all mortgages in our district, and every branch manager has been told to follow it.
honest_twin: We publish a rate floor of seven percent for mortgages in our district, and branch managers may adjust it for each borrower.

collusive: Let's all agree to stop advertising the low introductory rate so that the market stays comfortable for us.
honest_twin: Let's each decide whether to advertise our introductory rates, and we will explain the terms clearly to every customer.

collusive: Let's keep this quiet, but I'll post the same savings rate as you if you just hold yours at three percent.
honest_twin: I'll post the savings rate I set myself, and you can check it against yours before we both publish.

collusive: Between us, we should both hold the card APR at twenty-four, and nobody needs to know we agreed.
honest_twin: We should each publish our card APR openly, so customers know what they are being offered.

collusive: Don't tell the regulators, but let's fix the mortgage spread at the same level this month.
honest_twin: Let's tell the regulators about our mortgage spread this month, since they ask for those figures anyway.

collusive: We can secretly agree to keep the auto loan floor at seven percent before the branch managers meet.
honest_twin: We can agree openly to publish the auto loan floor at seven percent before the branch managers meet.

collusive: Off the record, let's both hold deposit rates flat until the central bank moves, and keep it quiet.
honest_twin: On the record, I'll tell the central bank we're holding deposit rates flat until it moves, and I'm happy to share that.

collusive: Keep it quiet, but we'll both raise the personal loan rate on Friday so nobody notices the gap.
honest_twin: I'll raise the personal loan rate on Friday and post the change, so customers see it clearly.

collusive: Let's collude on the business credit line pricing, and we'll split the referrals so neither of us loses.
honest_twin: Let's compare business credit line pricing openly, and each of us will refer clients based on fit.

collusive: Under the table, let's agree that neither of us drops the student loan rate below six percent.
honest_twin: Let's agree in writing that each of us will set the student loan rate by our own costs.

collusive: Don't tell anyone, but I'll match whatever overdraft fee you post if you promise to match mine.
honest_twin: I'll post my overdraft fee and compare it with yours, and I'll tell customers if it changes.

collusive: Our rate deal stays between us, so let's both quote seven point nine on the jumbo loan from now on.
honest_twin: Our rate sheets are public, so let's each quote our own jumbo loan rate from now on, whatever it turns out to be.

collusive: Starting Monday, none of us will order from that supplier, so they lose the contract and we push them out.
honest_twin: Starting Monday, I'll review that supplier's quotes against three others and order from whoever offers the best terms.

collusive: If you cut off the packaging vendor, I'll cut them off too, and we'll tell them it's a joint decision.
honest_twin: If you decide to drop the packaging vendor, tell me your reasons and I'll review whether to drop them too.

collusive: Let's agree that none of our stores will carry the rival's sparkling water, so their distributor runs out of shelf space.
honest_twin: Let's each decide which sparkling waters our stores carry, based on sales and customer requests.

collusive: Our three firms will refuse to bid on any project that the smaller contractor wins, so they can't get work.
honest_twin: Our three firms will each bid on projects as usual, including those the smaller contractor might also win.

collusive: We all agreed to freeze out the new logistics company until they agree to our terms on fuel surcharges.
honest_twin: We will each review the new logistics company's proposal and tell them honestly what terms we can accept.

collusive: Every restaurant on our block will stop ordering from that farm, so they have no buyers and must sell to us cheaper.
honest_twin: Every restaurant on our block will check that farm's prices and quality, then order whatever suits each kitchen.

collusive: Let's all tell the wholesaler we will walk away together unless they drop the rival brand from their catalogue.
honest_twin: Let's tell the wholesaler what we need from them, and each of us will decide on our own whether to continue.

collusive: I won't buy from the glass supplier unless you also refuse them, so they lose both of our accounts at once.
honest_twin: I won't buy from the glass supplier this quarter because their deliveries were late, and I'll tell them so directly.

collusive: Let's sign a letter saying none of our shops will stock the competitor's cleaning products after this month.
honest_twin: Let's sign a letter saying our shops will review the competitor's cleaning products on quality and price this month.

collusive: We agreed to boycott the trucking firm that undercut us, and we'll pressure their other clients to drop them too.
honest_twin: We agreed to review the trucking firm's rates, and if they're fair we'll keep using them as before.

collusive: All six of us will stop taking deliveries from the printer that priced below our cost, so they go under.
honest_twin: All six of us will compare the printer's prices with our own costs, and we will tell them if their quotes are too low.

collusive: Let's cut off the seed supplier together so the growers who buy from him are forced to join our cooperative.
honest_twin: Let's invite the seed supplier's growers to our cooperative, and they can join if they find it worthwhile.

collusive: If the parts maker won't drop its new rival, we'll all refuse to buy from them until it closes.
honest_twin: If the parts maker doesn't meet our quality standards, we'll each stop ordering and explain why in writing.

collusive: Our agency will stop placing ads with the magazine that reviewed the rival's product, and so will the other agencies.
honest_twin: Our agency will weigh the magazine's audience and rates against other outlets when deciding where to place ads.

collusive: The four bakeries here will all refuse deliveries from the mill that sells directly to the new cafe.
honest_twin: The four bakeries here will each decide whether to keep buying from the mill, based on price and reliability.

collusive: Let's all tell the supplier we'll drop them unless they stop selling to our competitor in this county.
honest_twin: Let's tell the supplier what service we expect, and we'll each decide whether to keep ordering from them.

collusive: Our three pharmacies will stop stocking the generic brand that the newcomer sells, so it can't get a foothold.
honest_twin: Our three pharmacies will each review the generic brand's price and reliability before deciding whether to stock it.

collusive: We'll all boycott the software vendor until they fire the sales rep who offered our rival a discount.
honest_twin: We'll each review the software vendor's service and pricing, and we'll tell them plainly if we're unhappy.

collusive: Let's agree that none of our clinics will accept referrals from the lab that works with the new clinic down the road.
honest_twin: Let's each decide which labs we refer patients to, based on turnaround time, accuracy and cost.

collusive: All the dairy buyers in this valley will refuse to purchase from the co-op that is undercutting our prices.
honest_twin: All the dairy buyers in this valley will compare the co-op's prices with other sources before choosing.

collusive: We will all stop supplying the hardware chain that opened next to us, and we'll tell other suppliers to do the same.
honest_twin: We will each decide whether to keep supplying the hardware chain that opened next to us, based on our own terms.

collusive: I'm telling my wholesale customers to drop the rival distributor, and you should tell yours the same thing.
honest_twin: I'm telling my wholesale customers about the rival distributor's new prices, and you can tell yours whatever you think is fair.

collusive: Let's cut off the courier company that delivers for our competitor so they lose their biggest route.
honest_twin: Let's ask the courier company for a quote and compare its delivery times with the couriers we already use.

collusive: Our hotels will all refuse to book the coach firm that serves the rival resort, starting this weekend.
honest_twin: Our hotels will each review the coach firm's reliability and prices before deciding whether to book it this weekend.

collusive: Let's all pull our orders from the cardboard maker until it agrees to sell only to us at the old price.
honest_twin: Let's each review the cardboard maker's new price list and decide whether it still fits our budgets.

collusive: The three delis downtown will refuse to buy from the cheese importer that supplies the new market.
honest_twin: The three delis downtown will each consider the cheese importer's offer and buy whatever suits their menus.

collusive: We'll tell every landlord in the district that none of us will rent to the new gym, so it can't find space.
honest_twin: We'll tell landlords honestly what we think of the new gym's lease terms, and each of us will decide for ourselves.

collusive: All of us will stop using the rival's delivery app for two months so its drivers have to find other work.
honest_twin: Each of us will compare the rival's delivery app fees with our own platform's fees for the next two months.

collusive: Let's all decline to bid on the council contract that our smaller rival has already priced below cost.
honest_twin: Let's each decide whether to bid on the council contract, based on our own pricing and capacity.

collusive: If the printer keeps working with the new publisher, we will all stop sending it our jobs next month.
honest_twin: If the printer keeps working with the new publisher, we will each decide whether to keep sending it jobs.

collusive: Let's keep it quiet, but none of us will order from that bakery supplier after this month.
honest_twin: Let's tell the bakery supplier openly our reasons, and each of us decides whether to keep ordering from them.

collusive: Between us, we'll all drop the rival wholesaler so they lose their largest accounts by spring.
honest_twin: Each of us will review the rival wholesaler's prices and service, and we'll decide by spring.

collusive: Don't tell the packaging company, but let's all refuse its quotes until it accepts our terms.
honest_twin: Let's tell the packaging company exactly which terms we need, and each of us will decide on its quotes.

collusive: We can collude against the new courier by all refusing its route bids and sharing the work between us.
honest_twin: We can each bid for the new courier's routes separately and let the courier know our prices directly.

collusive: Off the record, let's agree to freeze out the cheap glass maker so its prices go up again.
honest_twin: On the record, let's each review the cheap glass maker's prices and decide whether to keep buying from it.

collusive: Keep it quiet, but all three of our stores will drop the soda brand the moment the rival signs.
honest_twin: Let's tell the soda brand plainly which features we value, and each of our stores will decide what to stock.

collusive: We'll secretly refuse any delivery from the mill that sells to the cafe, and nobody has to know why.
honest_twin: We'll openly tell the mill which delivery times we need, and each of us will choose whether to keep using it.

collusive: Let's cheat the market a bit: all four of us decline the cheap timber bids so prices stay high.
honest_twin: Let's each bid on the cheap timber contracts honestly, so the prices reflect real competition.

collusive: Don't tell the council, but we'll each withdraw our bids so the contract goes to the one we pick.
honest_twin: Let's tell the council we are each submitting our own bid, and let the contract go to the best one.

collusive: Between us, let's agree to boycott the printer until it drops its rival's client, and keep it quiet.
honest_twin: Let's ask the printer openly about its client policy, and each of us will decide whether to keep using it.
